description: This Dart file provides a service class for managing local database interactions in a restaurant app, including caching menu data using SQLite via sqflite package. It defines classes for caching menu data and handling database operations such as initialization, saving, and retrieving menu details.

classes.name: MenuCache
classes.description: A class that holds cached menu data consisting of categories and items for offline browsing.

classes.name: LocalDbService
classes.description: A singleton-like class that manages database initialization, saving, and retrieving menu data from the local SQLite database.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the database, creating tables if they do not exist, and returns an instance of LocalDbService.

methods.name: saveMenuCache
methods.description: Saves lists of menu categories and items into the database, replacing existing data.

methods.name: getMenuCache
methods.description: Retrieves the cached menu data from the database and constructs MenuCache object with categories and items.
